en.headline: Government to discuss new 10-year franchises with KMB and NLB
en.dek: New Lantao Bus’s current franchise expires on 1 March 2027 and Kowloon Motor Bus’s on 1 July 2027; the public may comment until 28 September.
body: A government spokesman said on Friday the administration plans to discuss granting new 10-year franchises to New Lantao Bus Company (1973) Limited and The Kowloon Motor Bus Company (1933) Limited when their present franchises expire.

NLB’s current franchise ends on 1 March 2027 and KMB’s on 1 July 2027. Both operators have told the government they want new 10-year franchises. The spokesman said talks would aim to improve services and safety while keeping the companies’ operations and finances sound.

The Legislative Council Panel on Transport discussed the two operators’ services and the coming franchises on 20 March. Members of the public may send views to the Transport Department by post, fax or email at bus-franchise@td.gov.hk on or before 28 September 2026.

zh.headline: 政府擬與九巴及嶼巴商討新十年專營權
zh.dek: 嶼巴現行專營權明年3月1日屆滿，九巴則於7月1日屆滿，兩巴已表明有意申請新專營權，公眾可於9月28日前發表意見。
body: 政府發言人周五表示，當局計劃在新大嶼山巴士（1973）有限公司及九龍巴士（1933）有限公司現行專營權屆滿後，與兩巴商討批出新的十年專營權。
嶼巴現行專營權將於2027年3月1日屆滿，九巴則於2027年7月1日屆滿。兩間營辦商已向政府表明有意申請新的十年專營權。發言人稱，商討會在確保兩巴營運及財政穩健的前提下，推動提升服務及安全。
立法會交通事務委員會已於3月20日討論兩巴服務及新專營權事宜。市民可於2026年9月28日或之前，以郵寄、傳真或電郵bus-franchise@td.gov.hk向運輸署提交意見。
